items.headline: FDA clears first blood test for both ruling in and ruling out Alzheimer's in one step
items.summary: Regulators cleared a blood test from Roche and Eli Lilly that can both flag and rule out the brain plaques behind Alzheimer's disease, using a single result for adults fifty five and older with signs of cognitive decline. It's designed to run on thousands of lab machines already in use across primary care and specialty clinics.
items.why_it_matters: It could let far more people get an accurate Alzheimer's diagnosis from a simple blood draw instead of costly brain scans or spinal taps.
